I am 48 and this is my yearly skin reset. My morning skincare routine after my CO2 skin resurfacing consists of gentle cleansing, hypochlorous acid, Hyaluronic acid serum, with eye and face sunscreen. This treatment has 5 days of downtime but it’s so worth it!
